name: model
description: Set the model Claude Code starts with for new sessions unless a higher-precedence per-session override is supplied.

examples.explanation: Use the current Sonnet alias for new sessions by default.

when_to_use: Use when most new sessions should start with one model or alias.

conditions: Managed availableModels policy can restrict selection.

name: effortLevel
description: Persist the default reasoning effort for new Claude Code sessions.

examples.explanation: Start supported models with high reasoning effort by default.

when_to_use: Use when a consistent reasoning effort is appropriate across sessions.

conditions: Supported levels depend on the selected model.

name: permissions.defaultMode
description: Set the permission mode used when new Claude Code sessions start.

examples.explanation: Start new sessions in read-only plan mode by default.

when_to_use: Use to establish a safer or workflow-specific starting mode across sessions.
when_not_to_use: Use --permission-mode when only one invocation should differ.

conditions: Managed settings can override this value.
